sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the use of triclabendazole during breastfeeding. Because of protein binding of 96% to 99% for the drug and metabolites, exposure of the breastfed infant is likely to be low.
Drug Levels and Effects > Drug Levels

Triclabendazole is metabolized into its active sulfoxide metabolite, which is further metabolized to the active sulfone metabolite. These drugs have half-lives of 8, 14, and 11 hours, respectively.
